item.title: Event showcases how drones could be future of medical supply transport

item.title: UK household energy bills to drop by £150 amid price cap shake-up
item.description: British household energy bills are expected to go down by £150 this spring following government pledges.

item.title: North Wales estate and lettings agency celebrates 25 year milestone
item.description: The firm has been a familiar presence in the town since opening its Ruthin office a quarter of a century ago.

item.title: Llandudno guest house complete with tea room on the market for £500,000
item.description: A six-bedroom terraced house in the heart of Llandudno, perfectly set up as a guest house, is now on the market for offers over £500,000.

item.title: Conwy: Rural road to close for up to four weeks
item.description: A rural road will close for up to four weeks.

item.title: New webinar series launched by Chester Zoo and University of Chester
item.description: University of Chester and Chester Zoo launch conservation and sustainability webinar series, supporting UK professionals with green skills, climate policy, and career development.

item.title: Travel vloggers shows a North Wales town full of heart, character & reasons to visit
item.description: An episode of travel vlog Postcard And A Pint paints Rhyl in a warm, uplifting light — celebrating its seafront, culture and growing visitor offer - the vlog captures a town evolving with confidence and charm.

item.title: New home for Holiday on the Buses plaque after North Wales holiday park closure
item.description: In October 2004, the film, shot at the old Pontins site in 1973, was honoured as part of the North Wales Film and Television Trail.

item.title: Lidl gives update on plans to open new stores in Llandudno, Abergele and Rhyl
item.description: The plans are part of the German-owned chain's intention to open more than 40 new stores in the current financial year and invest half a billion pounds.

item.title: £33m funding confirmed for transformation of historic hospital after 13-year delay
item.description: The new purpose-built facility, at the site of the Royal Alex in Rhyl, will include a minor injuries unit capable of treating more than 20,000 people annually.
